headline: Brown beats Dartmouth and Columbia back to back
dek: Brown, which finished the conference table behind Dartmouth and Columbia, has since won at both without conceding. Its 41 goals in all matches are more than any other Ivy program has scored, and its record stands at twelve wins, two draws and four losses.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Brown's lead in goals rests on a broad base: at least 13 different players have scored for it, and Angelina Vargas, with eight, accounts for a small share of the 41.

wire.line: Brown has now won at both sides that finished above it in the Ivy table, and conceded in neither match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dartmouth's match against Assumption is past its date with no published result, the only Ivy match in that state.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ola Goebel has kept ten shutouts in goal for Dartmouth.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Dartmouth has conceded ten goals across all its matches.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Yale has scored 23 goals, more than Columbia, Cornell, Harvard or Penn. It has also lost ten of its matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Samantha Mahoney has made 59 saves for Columbia.

last_match.line: Brown has now beaten both sides that finished above it in the conference table.

next_match.line: Brown arrives having kept clean sheets against Dartmouth and Columbia.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
